question: Estimate monthly sales of 5-star refrigerators in a Tier 1 city like Pune.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual refrigerator sales × 5-star share × city contribution.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian refrigerator sales FY26: ~120 lakh units/year (12M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: 5-star BEE rated share (growing due to mandates + electricity savings): ~28-30% = ~35 lakh units/year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: By brand: LG ~22%, Samsung ~20%, Whirlpool ~15%, Haier ~12%, Bosch/Siemens premium ~8%, others 23%.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: 5-star BEE rated share (growing due to mandates + electricity savings)
Pune share of national refrigerator demand

benchmarkAssumptions.value: LG ~22%, Samsung ~20%, Whirlpool ~15%, Haier ~12%, Bosch/Siemens premium ~8%, others 23%.

calculationFlow: Indian refrigerator sales FY26: ~120 lakh units/year (12M).
5-star BEE rated share (growing due to mandates + electricity savings): ~28-30% = ~35 lakh units/year.
Pune share of national refrigerator demand: ~2.5% = ~85K units/year of 5-star.
